_comment: Chat lines, matched against the whole cleaned line. Area-specific patterns are added by each area's milestone. 'player_message', 'private_message' and 'channel_message' are only used to keep other players' messages out of the debug recorder.

fairy_soul_found: SOUL! You found a Fairy Soul!
fairy_soul_already: You have already found that Fairy Soul!
